When the puck went in

Source: R/tracking.R
goal_frame.Rd

The frame a goal was scored on: the first time the puck is over the goal line, between the posts and no deeper than the net, for two frames running, at the net it finishes the clip in. (The first frame in any net is wrong on about one goal in five: a clip can open with the puck at the other net, or blip over the line before the real goal.)

Usage

goal_frame(frames)

Arguments

frames

Tracking frames from nhl_goal_tracking().

Value

The frame number, or NA if the puck never goes in.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "goal-2025020534-777.json.gz", package = "bluelineR")
goal_frame(read_goal_tracking(path))
#> [1] 99
